sources.name: Annual Balance Sheets 2007-2022 (provisional) - all sectors by year
sources.assumptions: Non-produced non-financial assets ('land') at 31 March 2022: total economy $1,713,286m, of which government $86,390m. Excluding government land (not a land-tax base) leaves $1,626,896m taxable. No urban/rural split exists in this table (households, corporate, and government sectors only), and no more recent (2023/2024) vintage has been published.

sources.name: The Opportunities Party - Tax Reset (Land Value Tax policy)
sources.assumptions: States a 1.75% urban / 0.5% rural rate and an approximate $24bn/year revenue estimate. The 85%/15% urban/rural split applied to the Stats NZ total above is derived from that revenue estimate at these rates, not independently sourced - TOP's own costing has itself been publicly questioned (NZ Initiative) as not transparently derived.
